_comment: pr-shepherd config. Copy to ~/.claude/pr-shepherd.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every key is optional.
stop_topics: payments, billing, prices, payouts, balances or currency math

your-org/*._comment: Example: a review bot that posts a summary with a score. It passes only at full marks on the head commit.

your-org/service-with-a-panel._comment: Example: a panel of reviewers that reports how many of them passed. It passes only when N of N pass.
